clauses.reason: The order exempts Walter C. Sauer, First Vice President and Vice Chairman of the Export-Import Bank of the United States, from mandatory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5 of the United States Code until March 31, 1977. The order recites his earlier exemption until March 31, 1976 by Executive Order No. 11847 of March 28, 1975, an earlier order that is not a later event for this order. The order is a single command with one fixed term, so its own stated date is the first end: 1977-03-31, recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is 1977-03-30. The order was signed 1976-03-31. No amendment, revocation or shortening of this order is held (searched below).

research_rationale:
EO 11909 (signed 1976-03-31) is a one-person exemption under section 8335(c) of title 5, United States Code: Walter C. Sauer, First Vice President and Vice Chairman of the Export-Import Bank of the United States, is exempted from mandatory retirement for age until March 31, 1977. The held Federal Register text of the order was read in full and is a single operative clause (the recital, the finding of public interest, and the exempting sentence). The order ends by its own terms on 1977-03-31 (inclusive; exclusive alternative 1977-03-30, owner ruling 2026-10-21 on until dates). Searches judged adequate: U.S. Code and eCFR (no hit naming the order), the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note catalog, and a Cruden regex search of the held order texts for the person's surname, run by the producer, which found the chain members recorded above and nothing else. Whether the person left office on or before the stated date is not in any held source and is not asserted.

savings.reason: The exemption only suspended compulsory retirement for the stated term; it creates no continuing duty, office or rule. The person's service during the term and the pay for it had accrued by 1977-03-31; nothing in the order survives that date, and any later exemption is a separate grant recorded as a later event.
